summary: General Fusion Group Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting a change in its certifying accountant. On September 21, 2026, the Audit Committee appointed PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP, which had audited predecessor General Fusion Inc., as independent registered public accounting firm for fiscal year 2026, effective with Q3 2026 financials. Same day, WithumSmith+Brown resigned; its prior report contained a going-concern explanatory paragraph but no adverse opinion or disagreements. This is a routine auditor change following the July 10, 2026 SPAC business combination, not a special situation; no deal terms, premium, or board recommendation apply. Watch any restatement or internal-control disclosures.
